behavior: AC1: hit.js validates strictly, writes one five-blob data point, answers 400 or 204, handles POST only
AC2: the function reads no header and not request.cf and stores no extra field
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_hit_function.py -k 'nothing_of_the_request or extra_fields'

behavior: AC3: a utm landing sends one visit, strips the utm parameters; no utm sends nothing; a reload is not a second visit
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_metrics_beacon_browser.py -k 'flyer_scan_sends or only_the_utm or no_utm or reload_after or spanish_page'

behavior: AC4: every text link reports one text_tap with its item or bundle and the landing source, keeps its sms: href and is not cancelled
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_metrics_beacon_browser.py -k 'each_way_to_text or tap_on_a_desktop'

behavior: AC5: opening an item, including a linked one, reports a view_item
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_metrics_beacon_browser.py -k 'view or linked_item'

behavior: AC6: no payload holds the phone; the real sendBeacon is same-origin under connect-src 'self'; no new inline handler or host
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_metrics_beacon_browser.py tests/test_metrics_beacon.py -k 'phone or connect_src or another_origin or inline or one_beacon'

behavior: AC7: a share link keeps its utm_source to the catalog in both languages
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_metrics_beacon_browser.py tests/test_link_previews.py -k 'share_link or location'

behavior: AC8: wrangler.toml declares SALE_METRICS and the middleware passes /api/hit through
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_hit_function.py -k 'binding or middleware'

behavior: AC9: the n8n digest workflow is valid, scheduled, emailed, secret-free and its Code node reports what hit.js writes
AC10: ADR-011, the runbook sections and the teardown exist and name every variable and credential
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_sale_metrics_workflow.py -k 'runbook or decommission'

behavior: AC11: the new catalog browser tests are in CATALOG_TESTS and make check passes with sale_over on
